¿Restaurar todos los campos a sus valore: Restore all fields to their original values?
Esta área no tiene presupuestos asignado: This area has no assigned budgets for the current date.
No hay presupuesto activo para esta cate: There is no active budget for this category in the selected area.
⚠️ Este monto supera el disponible del p: ⚠️ This amount exceeds the available budget
Debes seleccionar la categoría del gasto: You must select the expense category.
La descripción debe tener al menos 10 ca: Description must be at least 10 characters long.
En un ingreso debes seleccionar la cuent: For an income you must select the destination account.
Debes proporcionar un motivo del cambio: You must provide a reason for the change (minimum 20 characters).
Obligatoria para ingresos. Aquí entrará: Required for income. The money will enter here.
Selecciona un monto para estimar impacto: Enter an amount to estimate impact
Selecciona la cuenta destino para regist: Select the destination account to record incoming funds. If the area has an active budget, you can assign a budget category.
Selecciona la cuenta origen para registr: Select the source account to record outgoing funds. If the transaction is a personal reimbursement, the system lets you use a linked user.
La categoría del presupuesto solo aparec: The budget category will only appear when the area has active budgets.
Obligatoria para egresos. Desde aquí sal: Required for expenses. Funds will be deducted from here.
No aplica para ingresos; el sistema usar: Does not apply to income; the system will use the destination account.
No aplica para egresos; el sistema usará: Does not apply to expenses; the system will use the source account.
El cambio en el monto es significativo (: The amount change is significant (%s%%). You must provide a reason.
En un egreso debes seleccionar la cuenta: For an expense you must select the source account or link a user.
¿Estás seguro de quitar %s de esta trans: Are you sure you want to remove %s from this transaction?
Formato no válido para \"%s\". Solo se a: Invalid format for "%s". Only PDF, JPG, and PNG are allowed.
Registra el pago de sueldo al colaborado: Records a salary payment to the contributor. This expense will appear in their Personal General Ledger (aura-user-ledger), count in their WordPress dashboard widget, and appear in the payroll accounting report.
Egreso destinado a un colaborador, prove: Expense directed to a contributor, individual vendor, or registered third party for services, direct purchases, or fees.
Ingreso recibido de un usuario por conce: Income received from a user for dues, monthly fees, enrollments, or internal service charges.
Egreso destinado al financiamiento educa: Expense intended for educational funding, aid, or direct financial support for a student or beneficiary.
Movimiento contable asociado al otorgami: Accounting entry associated with the issuance, installment, or full settlement of a financial loan with the user.
Devolución de dinero por cancelaciones,: Money refund due to cancellations, voids, or user credit balances in the system.
Restitución de dinero a un colaborador p: Repayment to a contributor for institutional expenses previously paid out of pocket.
